[BEDWARS]
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoConqueror (drops the banner you pick beside you when a fight starts, on attack or as soon as someone walks up)
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoSkoll (replaces AutoVoidHunter, throws Fenrir straight at your target instead of wherever your camera points, and picks when to set the mark off)
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoWhimElement (reads every Tome of the Elements it can reach so Whim unlocks its spells)
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoJade (slams the hammer down right before you land)
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoVoidRegent (the same landing slam with the void axe)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Minigame mode to AutoFish (Legit plays the catch bar out itself instead of winning the moment it opens)
[2;32m[+][0m Added AutoChestSplit (banks the split into your personal chest the second you are stood at one, so you do not lose it on the way home)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Auto owl to AutoWhisper (pick a teammate and the owl gets sent to them as soon as the ability is up)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Accuracy to Clutch (how close to the real fall damage limit it cuts it, lower catches you higher up with room to spare)
[2;32m[+][0m Added Damage to NoFall (how much of each fall still lands on you, so you are not the guy who never takes fall damage)
[2;34m[*][0m Reworked AutoTool
	-> Mode (Look swaps while you are still aiming at the block, Break is the old swap on first hit)
	-> Delay (how long you have to be looking at it before the swap)
	-> Switch back (puts the item you were holding back once you look away)
[2;33m[!][0m Fixed the GUI erroring on every injection (a removed legit module left its settings list connected)
